SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE:
SP. BR. REGISTRY
File No. 636
Special Branch 23 6 41
Station/
REPORT
Date June 20, 19 41.
Subject G.M. Tretiakoff, applicant for registration as candidate for position
of Police Watchman and/or Bodyguard.
Made by D.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by D.C.I. Tabrum.

George Mitrofanovich TRETIAKOFF, 27, a cossack
of Transbaikal Cossack Troops by origin, is the son of
the notorious M.N. TRETIAKOFF, Chairman of the "Russian
Anti-Communist Union in Shanghai", which in 1938-1940
was inclined to abuse the protection reportedly accorded
to them by certain Japanese circles or individuals and
therefore was a source of a considerable annoyance to
the S.M.Police.

From information on record it would appear that
the applicant participated in the activities of the Uni-
on during the latter part of 1938. Police report dated
4-11-38 concerning a case of illegal detention of a Rus-
sian resident mentions him as the person who actually
detained the complainant and handed him over to the Ja-
panese military authorities. After a few days' detention
the Russian resident concerned was released. No action
was taken in connection with this matter.

After his discharge from the Russian Regiment,
S.V.C., the applicant was employed as a junior fireman
with the S.P.Company from 28-3-39 to 27-6-39 when he
was discharged ( "Unsatisfactory" ). According to infor-
mation, his discharge had something to do with the fact of
discovery in June, 1939 of a copy of a pamphlet of an undesirable
nature issued by the "Russian Anti-Communist Union" post-
ed in the Mess Room of Russian employees of the S.P. Com-
pany. In fairness to the applicant, however, it must be
stated that there appeared to be no evidence whatsoever
to the effect that he was in any way concerned in this

日期 1941年6月20日。
事由 G.M. 特里亚科夫（Tretiakoff），申请登记为巡捕和/或保镖职位候选人。
由督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由副督察长塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）转呈。

乔治·米特罗法诺维奇·特里亚科夫（George Mitrofanovich TRETIAKOFF），27岁，原籍外贝加尔哥萨克部队哥萨克人，系臭名昭著的 M.N. 特里亚科夫之子。M.N. 特里亚科夫曾任“上海俄国反共联盟”主席，该组织在1938至1940年间倾向于滥用据称由某些日本圈子或个人给予他们的保护，因此给上海公共租界警务处带来了相当大的困扰。

根据存档资料显示，申请人似乎参与了该联盟在1938年后期的活动。一份日期为1938年11月4日的警务报告涉及一起非法拘禁俄国居民案件，报告中提及他是实际拘禁投诉人并将其移交给日本军方当局的人。该名相关俄国居民在被拘禁数天后获释。此事未采取任何进一步行动。

申请人在从义勇军（S.V.C.）俄国团退伍后，于1939年3月28日至1939年6月27日期间受雇于上海电力公司（S.P. Company）担任初级消防员，随后被解雇（评语为“不满意”）。据闻，其被解雇与1939年6月发现一份由“俄国反共联盟”发行的性质不良的小册子副本有关，该小册子被张贴在上海电力公司俄国员工的餐厅内。然而，公平起见，必须指出，似乎没有任何证据表明他以任何方式卷入了此

（左侧手写批注：）
8月2日收悉
归档

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 636
/Special/111
Date January 30, 1941.

Subject A.V. Walker - application for registration as candidate for position of Police Watchman.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J.I. Crawford.

Arvid Vikentievich WALKER alias WALTERS
alias WALIOT alias KOLIATOVSKY, Russian of Latvian origin, born on November 10, 1912 at Riga. According to his own statement, he left Vladivostok for Harbin in 1919 together with his parents and resided in that city until 1927 when he proceeded to Shanghai. Here he is known to have been working as a chauffeur.

He forms the subject of Criminal Record No. 1197 the particulars of which are as follows:-

| Court | Charge | Date of Sentence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Provisional | Breach of T.R. 10 and 14 | 21.6.28: $ 15 or 15 days. |
| " | Negligent driving causing death | 26.7.28: 2 months or $20.00. |
| " | Released on remission of sentence | 15.9.28 |
| " | Larceny | 30.12.29: 15 days plus 10 days R.C.D. |
| S.S.J.C. | Larceny | 9.4.30: 2 months |
| " | Breaking & Entering and Larceny | 30.6.30: 1 year |
| C.M.F. | Larceny | 5.9.30: 3 months |

Handed over to French Authorities on release from Settlement sentence 14.9.31.

On 19-2-32 he obtained Chauffeur's license from the S.M.Police under the name of A. Waliot. Issued during State of Emergency prior to receipt of finger print record the license was cancelled on 31.3.32 owing to his past criminal record.

报告
档案编号 636

日期 1941年1月30日。

事由 A.V. 沃克（Walker） - 申请登记为巡捕职位候选人。

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈。

阿尔维德·维肯季耶维奇·沃克（Arvid Vikentievich WALKER），别名沃尔特斯（WALTERS），别名瓦利奥特（WALIOT），别名科利亚托夫斯基（KOLIATOVSKY），拉脱维亚裔俄国人，1912年11月10日出生于里加。据其自述，他于1919年随父母离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往哈尔滨，并在该市居住至1927年，随后前往上海。据悉，他在上海从事司机工作。

他是刑事记录第1197号的对象，详情如下：-

| 法庭 | 指控 | 判决日期 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 临时法院 | 违反《土地章程》第10条和第14条 | 1928年6月21日：罚款15元或监禁15天。 |
| " | 疏忽驾驶致人死亡 | 1928年7月26日：监禁2个月或罚款20.00元。 |
| " | 因减刑获释 | 1928年9月15日 |
| " | 盗窃 | 1929年12月30日：监禁15天外加10天苦役（R.C.D.）。 |
| 上海第二特区地方法院 | 盗窃 | 1930年4月9日：监禁2个月 |
| " | 破门入室及盗窃 | 1930年6月30日：监禁1年 |
| 会审公廨 | 盗窃 | 1930年9月5日：监禁3个月 |

1931年9月14日，在服完租界刑期获释后，被移交给法国当局。

1932年2月19日，他以 A. 瓦利奥特（A. Waliot）的名义从上海公共租界警务处获得驾驶执照。由于该执照是在紧急状态期间、在收到指纹记录之前签发的，鉴于其过去的犯罪记录，该执照于1932年3月31日被注销。
